_comment: Row 722 G5 live (tiny4k.com SPA scene page, 2026-09-15): the DOM held no download control; the page's own /api/members/releases/<slug> JSON carried filename-only downloadOptions (1080 listed first, 2160 present) plus direct 1080/720/480 stream URLs. M1 drops the filename-only resolution (the record's downloads?filename= sub-resource), so the best fetchable URL regresses to the 1080 stream. M2 makes the ranking ignore resolution, so list order wins and the 1080 option is chosen over 2160.
